description: Historical (fixed in d23c6d4, "fix: terminal title crash"): `Tackle.CLI.TerminalTitle.clear/0` returns `emit/1`'s `{:ok, :applied}` although its spec promises `:ok`, so the TUI's `case writer.(nil) do :ok -> ... end` raises CaseClauseError when the title is cleared on exit.

issues.anchor: if Native.stdout_is_terminal(), do: osc0("") |> emit(), else: :ok
issues.description: `clear/0` returns `{:ok, :applied}` from `emit/1` on a terminal, not the `:ok` its spec promises, so `TUI.TerminalTitle.clear/1` (`case writer.(nil) do :ok -> ...`) crashes with a CaseClauseError when the title is cleared on exit. A finding at the crash site or at `emit/1` counts too.
